### Changed
- **`components.klaus-gateway.versionRange` admits the 2.x line (`>=1.20.0 <3.0.0`)** (giantswarm/klaus-gateway#319). klaus-gateway 2.0.0 is the Slack-only gateway: the web and CLI channels, the OpenAI-compatible `/v1` front door and the Klaus instance path are removed there; the values keys this chart still forwards for them (`cli`, `lifecycle`, `upstream`, `agentgateway`, `routing.defaultTTL`, `a2a.saToken`) are accepted by the 2.x chart as no-ops, so the installations roll to it unchanged. Those keys leave this chart in a later change, once the 2.x line has rolled.
